about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One Proofline task, XC-47, for S5 (every kind /supported advertises gets a verdict from /verify), which merged in #45. It follows the v1.5 checks addendum (XC-39 to XC-46) and is meant to be signed after it. Nothing here is binding and vv does not read this file. The task becomes part of the contract only when the owner merges it into proofline.json and re-signs it with the owner key pinned in guard/owner.pub. It has the shape of XC-46 (F12): the unittest form with a minimum test count, then the catalogue, SPEC row, FIXES section, scope and push. The requirement id is R-S5, after R-S1 to R-S4 under XC-01.

tasks.title: S5: every kind /supported advertises gets a verdict from /verify
tasks.description: Every (scheme, network, x402Version) kind a facilitator advertises in /supported gets a structured /verify answer: isValid true, or isValid false with an invalidReason, never an error. V2 7.1 and 7.3.

criteria.statement: S5 passes the reference double and catches a facilitator that advertises a kind its /verify can't answer, or refuses it with no reason
S5 is in the check catalog with its profile, spec basis, control and faulty build, the TypeScript catalog matches it, and it has a fix section
Every changed file is inside this task's scope

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass, STOP and report what blocks it, what was tried and what is needed. Never weaken a criterion, skip a test or raise a timeout to make it pass.
